title: Employees on Team Alpha but not Team Beta
prompt: Return the employee_name (column: employee_name) of employees assigned to the 'Alpha' team but NOT assigned to the 'Beta' team, using EXCEPT between two subqueries on the assignments table.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE assignments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, employee_name TEXT, team TEXT); INSERT INTO assignments VALUES (1,'Kai Nordahl','Alpha'),(2,'Kai Nordahl','Beta'),(3,'Lena Ruiz','Alpha'),(4,'Milo Petrov','Beta'),(5,'Nadia Voss','Alpha'),(6,'Oren Katz','Alpha'),(7,'Oren Katz','Beta');
reference_sql: SELECT employee_name FROM assignments WHERE team = 'Alpha' EXCEPT SELECT employee_name FROM assignments WHERE team = 'Beta';
